name: findpeaks
comment: Sig [pks,locs]=findpeaks(Y[,X|Fs],Name,Value). Default = strict local maxima (1-based idx), row in / row out. Options: MinPeakHeight (keep value>MPH, strictly), Threshold (min vertical drop to neighbors >=), MinPeakDistance (greedy tallest-first, remove peaks within distance, output by location), NPeaks (first N after SortStr), SortStr none/ascend/descend (by height, ties=ascending location). findpeaks(Y,X)/findpeaks(Y,Fs) report X-unit/time locations. numkit previously IGNORED every option -- now honored. MinPeakProminence/width outputs deferred (error loudly). Matches MATLAB R2025b.
